spec.description: by route and http status code

spec.expr:
(
  sum(
    rate(
      traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_count{
        rems_application_group="$ApplicationGroup",
        rems_service="$service",
        rems_environment="$env",
        span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",
        http_status_code!~"^2.*|^3.*",
        rpc_grpc_status_code="",
        http_status_code!="",
        http_route=~"$route"
      }[5m]
    ) or on() vector(0)
  )
  +
  sum(
    rate(
      traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_count{
        rems_application_group="$ApplicationGroup",
        rems_service="$service",
        rems_environment="$env",
        span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",
        rpc_grpc_status_code!~"^0$",
        http_status_code="",
        rpc_grpc_status_code!="",
        http_route=~"$route"
      }[5m]
    ) or on() vector(0)
  )
)
* 100
/
sum(
  rate(
    traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_count{
      span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",
      rems_application_group="$ApplicationGroup",
      rems_service="$service",
      rems_environment="$env",
      http_route=~"$route"
    }[5m]
  )
)

spec.expr:
# Calculates CPU throttling ratio per pod and container.
#
# Query Logic:
# - container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total
#   -> Number of CPU periods where the container was throttled.
#
# - container_cpu_cfs_periods_total
#   -> Total CPU scheduling periods assigned to the container.
#
# - increase(metric[$__rate_interval])
#   -> Calculates counter increase during the selected Grafana time range.
#
# - throttled_periods / total_periods
#   -> Returns CPU throttling ratio.
#      Example:
#        0.10 = 10% throttling
#        0.50 = 50% throttling
#
# - group by (pod, container)
#   -> Displays throttling metrics at pod and container granularity.
#
# - kube_pod_labels filter
#   -> Filters workloads using:
#        rems_application_group
#        rems_service
#        rems_environment
#
# Use Case:
# Helps identify Kubernetes workloads experiencing CPU throttling
# due to restrictive CPU limits.

(
  sum(
    increase(
      container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{
        job="kubelet",
        metrics_path="/metrics/cadvisor",
        pod=~"^$service.*$",
        container!="",
        # cluster="$cluster"
      }[$__rate_interval]
    )
  ) by (container, pod)
  /
  sum(
    increase(
      container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{
        job="kubelet",
        metrics_path="/metrics/cadvisor",
        pod=~"^$service.*$",
        container!="",
        # cluster="$cluster"
      }[$__rate_interval]
    )
  ) by (container, pod)
)
* on(pod) group_left(rems_application_group, rems_service)
(
  kube_pod_labels{
    rems_application_group="$ApplicationGroup",
    rems_service="$service",
    rems_environment="$env"
  }
)

spec.description:
Shows CPU throttling for each pod and container.

CPU throttling happens when a container tries to use more CPU than its configured CPU limit, and Kubernetes restricts it.

Higher values indicate the application may be CPU starved and could experience performance issues or slow response times.
spec.title: Pod:  CPU Throttling
